title: RM50,000 Untuk Karim
notes: Source of truth for Episode 4 TTS, timed bilingual subtitles, TransferOfferHUD, the 1.3s dead silence and SFX cues. Boss / Coach / Karim dialogue only (no narrator-only stretches) in casual spoken Malay with a smaller English translation line. No CTAs. Frame 0 opens at full brightness on the sliding offer paper with a paper-slide transient and a 1.5s HookTitle. Ends on Karim's doorway line, a muted low bass hit and a hard cut to the black Buluh FC / EPISOD 4 title card. All e4_ clips are lead-silence trimmed.

scenes.name: Scene 1 — The Bomb Drops
scenes.environment: ClubOfficeApp (tight low-angle push-in across the desk lamp)
scenes.visual: Frame 0 at full brightness: Boss's hand slides the offer sheet across the warm wood desk toward camera. First major angle cut at frame 45 to a closer Boss framing. HookTitle spring-pops for frames 0–45.
scenes.sfx: Frame-0 paper-slide transient; low-tension indoor office drone/ambience starts under the voice.
scenes.bgm: Low-tension office drone, ducked under the Boss line.

events.note: Paper insert -> closer Boss framing (first major shift by frame 60).

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Kelab Divisyen Empat baru hantar tawaran. Lima puluh ribu untuk Karim.
lines.translation: A Division 4 club just sent an offer. 50K for Karim.

scenes.name: Scene 2 — Heart vs. Survival
scenes.environment: ClubOfficeApp (shot-reverse-shot between Coach and Boss; tactics whiteboard behind Coach)
scenes.visual: Shot-reverse-shot that escalates closer each exchange: medium two-shot -> Coach OTS -> Boss OTS -> tight singles. Coach leans in and gestures; Boss keeps his hands on the paper then spreads them. Tactics whiteboard on the wall behind the Coach.
scenes.sfx: Low-tension office drone/ambience continues, ducked under dialogue. No hard SFX in this scene.
scenes.bgm: Office drone holds a slow pulse, ducked under every line.

events.note: Tight Coach single -> tight Boss single.
TransferOfferHUD out at e4_06 end (absolute frame 897).

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Kau biar betul? Musim baru nak mula, kau nak jual kapten kita?
lines.translation: Are you serious? The season's about to start and you're selling our captain?

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Karim baru dua puluh lapan. Friendly lepas dia MVP! Semua serangan kita jalan sebab dia kat tengah.
lines.translation: Karim's only 28. He was MVP last friendly! Our entire attack runs through him in midfield.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Aku tahu, coach. Aku pun tengok game tu.
lines.translation: I know, coach. I watched that game too.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Tapi tengok akaun kelab ni. Lima puluh ribu memang tak banyak, tapi cukup untuk kita bernafas.
lines.translation: But look at the club's accounts. 50K isn't much, but it's enough to keep us breathing.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Lagi satu... gaji Karim paling tinggi dalam skuad. Kalau dia keluar, kos gaji kita terus turun.
lines.translation: And one more thing... Karim's our highest earner. If he leaves, our wage bill drops immediately.

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Kalau dia keluar, siapa nak kawal padang? Kita nak menang ke nak cukup syarat je?
lines.translation: If he leaves, who controls the pitch? Are we here to win or just make up the numbers?

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Tak ada guna menang satu game kalau bulan depan kelab ni dah tak mampu bayar gaji budak-budak lain.
lines.translation: No point winning one match if next month we can't pay the rest of the squad.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Keputusan aku muktamad. Kita terima tawaran tu.
lines.translation: My decision is final. We're taking the offer.

scenes.name: Scene 3 — The Doorway Cliffhanger
scenes.environment: ClubOfficeApp (slow pan past Boss's shoulder to the half-open, cooler-backlit doorway)
scenes.visual: 1.3s dead silence (frames 1335–1373) as the Boss reaches for the pen and room tone drops out. Slow eased pan past his shoulder to the half-open door; Karim stands in the cooler hallway light wearing the Buluh FC Match Jersey with KARIM and 8 on the back, captain's armband on his left sleeve, boots in one hand. He lifts his head as he steps into the light.
scenes.sfx: Near-silent pen tap at local frame 21 (absolute 1356); muted dramatic low bass hit on e4_10 (local frame 39 / absolute 1374); office drone returns at low level under Karim's line.
scenes.bgm: Room tone absent through the silence beat; low drone fades back in under Karim, then cuts to black.

events.note: 1.3s dead silence after e4_09; room tone drops out.
Muted low bass hit on e4_10.
Slow pan past shoulder to Karim in the doorway.
Cut to black title card at absolute frame 1458.

lines.speaker: KARIM
lines.text: Bos... betul ke apa yang aku dengar tadi?
lines.translation: Boss... is what I just heard true?

scenes.name: Outro Title Card
scenes.visual: Hard cut to clean black card: Buluh FC / thin gold divider / EPISOD 4. No CTA.
